1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22942]MildKewy Food Starter[/url]
4. Download the mod file, unzip it, and then paste it in Mods.[/list][/center][list=1]
